The additional delivery

time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Generic The seller is required to print logo as per buyer's requirement. 3. Generic Experience Criteria: The Bidder or its OEM {themselves or through reseller(s)} should have regularly, manufactured and supplied same or similar Category Products to any Central / State Govt Organization / PSU for 3 years before the bid opening date. In case of bunch bids, the primary product having highest value should meet this criterion. 4. Turnover Bidder Turn Over Criteria: The minimum average annual financial turnover of the bidder during the last three years, ending on 31st March of the previous financial year, should be as indicated in the bid document. Documentary evidence in the form of certified Audited Balance Sheets of relevant periods or a certificate from the Chartered Accountant / Cost Accountant indicating the turnover details for the relevant period shall be uploaded with the bid. In case the date of constitution / incorporation of the bidder is less than 3 year old, the average turnover in respect of the completed financial years after the date of constitution shall be taken into account for this criteria. 5. Inspection Testing of Sample: The testing of advance sample and bulk sample during PDI will be carried at the designated AHSP labs.When testing facilities are not available, the facilities of Govt labs/NABL/Accredited labs will be utilized. The testing charges outside the designated AHSP labs to be borne by seller's. 6. Scope of Supply Supply of printed educational items comprising Notebook with Departmental Information and scheme logo in English , Pencil, Sharpener and Ruler as per the specifications and quantities prescribed in the Bid/ATC. 2. Schedule of Requirement Sl. No. Item Specification Quantity 1 Notebook Size: 24 cm × 18 cm; 92 pages; Single Line rul 3,36,000 ing; as per specifications 2 Pencil As per specifications 3,36,000 3 Sharpener As per specifications 3,36,000 4 Ruler As per specifications 3,36,000 3. Quality and Sample Approval

· The Notebook cover shall contain the Department information & scheme Logo with official information . · The official information and artwork shall be collected by the Bidder from the Directorate for prior appr oval. · Prior approval of the sample from the Director, Non-Formal and Adult Education, Jatia, Kahilipara, Guw ahati-19, is mandatory. · The Bidder shall submit the required sample(s) after work allocated. Failure to submit the sample withi n the prescribed time may render the Bid liable for rejection. · All items supplied shall confirm to the prescribed specifications and shall be of standard quality. All the items shall be as per the specifications. 4. Delivery The items shall be delivered to the Field Officers/field-level offices in all 35 Districts of Assam, at the lo cations specified by the Buyer. The Seller shall bear all costs of packaging, transportation, loading, unloading, handling and distributio n from the Seller’s premises up to the office of the concerned Member Secretary, District Literacy Mission Authority (DLMA), and the respective field-level offices. No additional transportation or distribution charges shall be borne by the Buyer. The Seller shall be responsible for safe and timely delivery and shall make all necessary arrangements for transportation and distribution up to the respective field-level offices within the stipulated time. Delivery shall be completed within 15–30 days from the date of issue of the Supply Order. Delivery Districts (35 Districts): Bajali, Baksa, Barpeta, Biswanath, Bongaigaon, Cachar, Charaideo, Chi rang, Darrang, Dhemaji, Dhubri, Dibrugarh, Dima Hasao, Goalpara, Golaghat, Hailakandi, Hojai, Jorhat, Ka mrup (M), Kamrup (R), Karbi Anglong, Kokrajhar, Lakhimpur, Majuli, Morigaon, Nagaon, Nalbari, Sivasagar, Sonitpur, South Salmara-Mankachar, Sribhumi, Tamulpur, Tinsukia, Udalguri and West Karbi Anglong. 5. Bid Price · The total price quoted by the Bidder shall be inclusive of all applicable taxes, duties, transportation cha rges, loading and unloading charges, handling charges, distribution expenses and all other incidental e xpenses associated with supply and delivery. · The quoted price shall remain firm and inclusive of all such charges for the entire duration of the contr act period. · No additional payment on account of the above expenses shall be admissible by the Buyer. · The price of each items shall be inclusive of all taxes including delivery/transportation and labour costs to the field offices in all 35 districts,. 6. Option Clause – Variation in Quantity · The Buyer reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered by up to 25% of the bi d quantity at the time of placement of the Contract. · Where the option clause is exercised, the delivery period for the additional quantity shall commence fr om the last date of the original delivery period. If exercised during an extended delivery period, the ad ditional delivery period shall commence from the last date of the extended delivery period. · Additional Delivery Time = (Increased Quantity ÷ Original Quantity) × Original Delivery Period (in day s). · The additional delivery time shall be subject to a minimum period of 10 days. Where the original delive ry period is less than 10 days, the additional delivery time shall be equal to the original delivery period . · The Buyer may, at its discretion, extend the calculated additional delivery period by up to the original

delivery period while exercising the option clause. · The Bidder shall arrange the additional quantity within the prescribed delivery period at the contracted rates and conditions. 7. Pre-Qualification/Eligibility Criteria Ø Registration of Firm/Company The Bidder/Firm/Company shall have a registered office in Assam for a minimum period of 5 years. Docum entary evidence such as GST Registration Certificate, valid Trade License, Lease/Rent Agreement or other applicable registration documents shall be furnished. Ø PAN and GST Compliance A self-attested copy of the Bidder’s PAN Card/PAN document shall be furnished.The Bidder shall possess a valid GST Registration and shall furnish documentary evidence of GST payment and filing of GST returns fo r the preceding 3 financial years, as applicable. Ø Non-Blacklisting The Bidder shall submit an affidavit/declaration stating that the Bidder/Firm/Company has never been blac klisted or debarred by any State Government/Central Government Department, Government Organization, PSU or other Government agency for breach of contractual conditions or fraudulent, unethical or corrupt b usiness practices. Ø Declaration of Eligibility The Bidder shall submit an affidavit/declaration stating that the Bidder/Firm/Company is not under any dec laration of ineligibility for indulging in corrupt or fraudulent practices, or for any other cause, by the Govern ment of Assam, any other State Government, or the Government of India.The Bidder must submit Bank Sol vency Certificate issued by their banker. 8. Submission of Tender Information All the information specified below is mandatory and shall be submitted on the Bidder’s letterhead: Sl. No. Particulars Information 1 Name & Address of the Bidder 2 Contact Number 3 Fax Number 4 Email Address 5 GST Registration No. 6 Income Tax PAN No. 7 Bid Security Details 8 Transaction/RTGS No. 9 Name & Full Address of the Bank and Branch through w hich RTGS is made The Bidder shall also furnish an undertaking confirming acceptance of all terms and conditions prescribed i n the Bid Document, duly signed and sealed by the authorized signatory. 9. Clarification / Query Regarding Bid Docum ents

A prospective Bidder requiring clarification regarding the Bid Document may submit queries in writing to t he State Literacy Mission Authority (SLMA) through GeM or through the email address specified in the GeM Bid, within the prescribed date and time. The response to queries/clarifications shall be communicated to prospective Bidders, as deemed appropria te, by hosting the clarification/amendment on GeM in accordance with the applicable provisions. Queries shall be submitted in the following format: Sl. No. Page No. Clause No. Ref. Subject Clarification Sought Note: Queries not submitted in the prescribed format may not be considered or responded to. 10.Pre-Bid Meeting A pre-bid meeting is scheduled on 3 days before the bid end date at the office chamber of the Director, No n-Formal and Adult Education, Assam, Jatia, Kahilipara Road, Guwahati-19, as stated in the source ATC. 11.Amendment / Corrigendum to Bid Docume nt · At any time prior to the deadline for submission of Bids, the Buyer may, on its own initiative or in respo nse to a request for clarification from any prospective Bidder, modify or amend the Bid Document by is suing an Addendum, Amendment or Corrigendum. · Any Addendum, Amendment or Corrigendum shall be uploaded/published on the GeM Portal and shall form an integral part of the Bid Document. · All prospective Bidders shall be deemed to have taken note of and complied with such Addendum, Am endment or Corrigendum while submitting their Bids. · The Buyer reserves the right, at its discretion, to extend the deadline for submission of Bids, wherever considered necessary, to provide prospective Bidders with reasonable time to take into account any a mendment, clarification, or modification issued in connection with the Bid. 12.Delivery Documentation, Inspection and A cceptance · After successful delivery of the items in good and satisfactory condition at the designated locations, th e Bidder/Supplier shall furnish delivery challans duly acknowledged and countersigned by the concerne d Field Officer, with the official seal of the respective district/field-level office. · Bills/invoices shall be raised in triplicate in the name of the Tender Inviting Authority, along with four c opies of delivery challans and No Defect Certificates duly signed by the concerned Inspectors of Sch ools of respective Districts, with stock-page entry on the body of the challans. · Supplies received in damaged condition shall not be accepted. · Payment shall be made after delivery of goods in satisfactory condition and confirmation of receipt in good and satisfactory condition by the concerned inspecting/field authority. 13.Penalties/Liquidated Consequences

· The Buyer reserves the right to cancel the Contract in case of unsatisfactory service/performance by th e Bidder/Supplier after award of the Contract. · In case the Vendor fails to complete the supply within the stipulated period, a penalty for delay at the r ate of 1% of the value of the Supply Order shall be charged for each week or part thereof, subject to a maximum of 10% of the total amount of the Supply Order. 14.Termination of Contract · The Directorate of Non-Formal and Adult Education, Assam, without prejudice to any other remedy ava ilable under the Contract or applicable rules, shall have the right to terminate the Contract, in whole or in part, in the event of breach of any terms and conditions by the Bidder. · The Directorate may terminate the Contract if the Bidder fails to deliver the materials within the period specified in the Contract or within such extended period as may be granted. · The Directorate may also terminate the Contract if the Bidder fails to perform or fulfil any other obligat ion stipulated under the Contract/Bid Document or otherwise directed in accordance with the Contract. · Termination shall be without prejudice to the right of the Directorate to recover loss, damages, additio nal expenditure or other dues arising from the Supplier’s failure, as permissible under the Contract and applicable rules. 15.Arbitration and Jurisdiction Ø Arbitration In the event of any question, dispute or difference arising under the Agreement or in connection therewith, except matters for which a specific decision is provided under the Agreement, the matter shall be dealt wit h in accordance with the dispute-resolution/arbitration provisions applicable to the Contract. The source ATC provides that the Directorate of Non-Formal and Adult Education, Assam, or its designated representative shall act as the arbitrator. The source ATC further provides that where the dispute cannot be resolved through arbitration within 30 d ays from commencement of arbitration, the legal dispute may be pursued before the courts under the juris diction specified therein. Ø Jurisdiction Any dispute arising out of or in connection with the Contract shall be subject to the jurisdiction of the comp etent courts at Guwahati, Assam, as stated in the source ATC. 16.
